messages:
maria: Quick question — prototype for compact usage landed in Figma. Main ask: should the invoice CTA be a sticky header pill or per-card link? Want minimal clutter but high discoverability.

jonah: sticky pill wins for discoverability. Per-card links ok but subtle. Header pill should show scope name and be keyboard-focusable.

rebecca: perf note: if we render 30 cards, avoid fetching full token rows. API returns totals + small sparkline; detail fetched on expand. Use intersection observer + keyboard focus to prefetch.

sam-a11y: accessibility: header pill needs aria-label "Download invoice for current scope" and visible focus styles. Grid needs roving tabindex for arrow nav. Also fix color contrast on delta chips (current mock <4.5:1).

leah: CS prefers header pill + per-card micro-link labeled "Download invoice (CSV)". Also request the pill show timeframe like "Download invoice (Mar 2026)".

maria: sounds good. Action items: Jonah update mock with header pill + micro-link; Rebecca add ?prefetch=focus and X-Total-Count header; Sam provide exact ARIA strings; Leah draft support blurb. Plan: prototype to 2% of orgs behind flag `compact-usage-grid`.
